name: Social Post
description: Allows posting content to different social networks automatically
project_description:
This project is part of the Drupal Social Initiative and is based on the Social API . 

 

 Social Post is part of the Social API. It provides a common interface for creating modules related to autoposting to social network services. Note: this module does not do much on it's own. Install one of the implementors (some examples listed below) for actual functionality.

 
 This module defines a path /admin/config/social-api/social-post which displays a table of implementers (modules to autopost to social network services on users' behalf). 
 This module does not restrict the way an implementer module provides its functionality. This allows the implementers to adapt to the social network's requirements they implement. 
 
 Current Implementers 
 
 
 Social Post Facebook 
 
 
 Social Post LinkedIn 
 
 
 Social Post Slack 
 
 
 Social Post Twitter
